purpose: Teach: 漂っ/見当たら/神さま/ひまわり/ペットボトル/なぞ/吸う/はじまっ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、キッチンから、いい香りが、漂ってるね。
lines.en: Mom, there's such a nice smell coming from the kitchen.
lines.style: Bright, curious observation — words tumble out. Quick breathing between phrases, genuine wonder without performance. Nose lifted slightly, catching the scent.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。玩具の鍵、どこにも見当たらないわね、翔くん、知らない?
lines.en: Mm-hmm. That toy key — I can't find it anywhere. Sho, have you seen it?
lines.style: Thoughtful, gentle distraction. Pauses between thoughts — not quite worried, but mentally turning something over. Warm underlying tone, the voice of someone asking while doing something else.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 神さまに、お願いしたよ、テスト、頑張れますように。
lines.en: I prayed to God about my test. That I'll do well.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. Small, serious voice — no theatrics. Breath steady. The kind of honesty a child offers without checking for judgment first.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お庭の、ひまわり、今年も、咲いたわね、立派に。
lines.en: The sunflowers in the garden bloomed again this year, didn't they. So beautiful.
lines.style: Soft, observant warmth. Speaking as if Sho is beside her, noticing together. Slight trailing affection on the final word — the voice of someone genuinely moved by small, recurring things.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お水、ペットボトル、ぼく、リサイクルに出すよ。
lines.en: I'm going to take the water bottle and put it in recycling.
lines.style: Quiet pride — matter-of-fact delivery but with a small glow underneath. Not asking permission, but telling with gentle confidence. The voice of someone pleased with his own thoughtfulness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: なぞなぞ、お父さんに、出してみたら、面白がるわよ。
lines.en: Try telling Dad one of your riddles. He'll get a real kick out of it.
lines.style: Encouraging warmth, gentle suggestion. Light, playful tone — imagining his pleasure beforehand. A half-smile in the voice, the comfort of knowing what will make someone happy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お外で、新鮮な空気、吸うと、気持ちいいね、ママ。
lines.en: Breathing the fresh air outside feels so good, doesn't it, Mom.
lines.style: Wonder mixed with gentle sharing — offering the moment to her. Slow, savoring pace. Small breath between 'outside' and the rest, as if pausing to actually feel it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 夏休み、もうはじまったわね、楽しみがいっぱいね、翔くん。
lines.en: Summer's already started. There's so much to look forward to, Sho.
lines.style: Close, warm, almost conspiratorial. Soft voice — she's settled now, speaking as if it's just the two of them in a quiet moment. Affectionate on his name, with an undertone of maternal tenderness.
